## Release

- Minecraft: 26.3.x (tested target: 26.3)
- Loaders: Fabric and NeoForge (beta)
- Java: 25
- Version: 5.6.0+mc26.3

## Changes

- Added dedicated Minecraft 26.3 projects for Fabric and NeoForge.
- Updated Fabric Loader to 0.19.5 and Fabric API to 0.160.6+26.3.
- Updated NeoForge to 26.3.0.3-beta and Gradle to 9.6.0.
- Preserved the existing gamerule IDs, defaults, loot modes and translations.
- Restricted Minecraft compatibility to >=26.3 <26.4.
